_comment: Enhanced + remapped generation manifest. Supersedes imagery-manifest.json. Generated via Higgsfield browser UI on the unlimited trial (free models only).
changes: Services remapped from 8 stale disciplines to the 5 live offers in lib/services.ts (consolidated 2026-07-28).
Project accents corrected to match lib/project-showcase.ts: P03 #1A3DE8 -> #5196FD, P04 #0E9F6E -> #764BA2.
Model switched off recraft_v4_1 (not on the unlimited tier) to Seedream 4.5 for editorial Family A and Nano Banana Pro for Family B device mockups.
Prompts enhanced: explicit camera/lens, single-hue dominance reinforced, thumbnail legibility for hero tiles, hardened no-text negatives for mockups.

PILOT FIX after H02: 'natural colour grade' was fighting 'one dominant hue owning the frame' and produced desaturated sepia instead of an amber wash. Replaced with 'saturated single-hue colour grade with a strong unmistakable colour cast' on the 21 colour-wash images; kept a natural grade on the 10 natural-scene-with-one-accent images. Also widened the 3 hero portraits from extreme macro to head-and-shoulders.

PILOT FIX 2 after S1: my rewrite had dropped the literal hex codes the original prompts carried, so crimson drifted to burgundy. Appended an explicit 'dominant hue must be exactly hex <accent>' clause to all 32 prompts.

REVISION on Promit's feedback: the first web-development mockup read as a flat grey wireframe. Rewrote P03/P04/P06 screen content to read as real designed product work (gradient hero panels, overlapping cards, real charts, saturated accent colour, depth) while keeping the hard no-readable-text constraint that stops garbled fake UI copy.
P01/P02 reassigned to Seedream 4.5 - they are natural editorial product photography (flat lay, collateral set), not device mockups, so the film-grain photographic model fits better than the UI model.

Promit feedback round 2: (a) too many laptop/computer mockups - added a 6-image AVELUNE brand application set covering packaging, signage, stationery, in-hand app, outdoor and apparel, and barred devices from P05; (b) reworked P05 from a screen to a strobe multiple-exposure dancer.

Promit feedback round 3: (a) removed literal 'plain white' backgrounds, replaced with saturated gradient backdrops; (b) Miro board checked — Envato links are all After Effects video templates (not usable for stills), Pinterest pins require login so actual visual content couldn't be fetched; applied the described aesthetic (glassmorphism/claymorphism/neumorphism/chromatic aberration/prism) directly via prompt language on a handful of images instead; (c) replaced single-brand AVELUNE-only projects set with a 5-brand, 5-industry mix (skincare, consumer tech, restaurant, real estate, financial services) - 16 brand images total, trimmed AVELUNE from 6 to 4.

Added 3 'capability showcase' images (G01-G03: web development, AI automation, brand design) styled after the bold flat-colour-block, screen-grid Envato agency-promo aesthetic (checked 2 Envato template preview pages directly - both use near-black backgrounds, one saturated flat colour block, and confident geometric type bars over screen/phone tiles). These are Solve Trend's own capability demos, not client-brand mockups.

Promit feedback round 4: capability-showcase screen/UI mockups (G01-G03) read as generic AI stock imagery. Reworked into pure abstract material/light still lifes matching the hero Family A aesthetic (glass+steel lattice, glass-sphere node cluster, ink-and-paper) - no screens, no UI, no devices at all. Switched model to Seedream 4.5 to match the rest of the abstract editorial set.

Promit feedback round 5: no more lifestyle-couch/interior phone shots - they read as generic AI stock. Rewrote every in-hand phone prompt (AVELUNE app, AERON app, ROSEMONT app) into a no-hand, no-room hero product-reveal shot: modern all-screen iPhone-style device floating against a single-hue or two-tone gradient void with a soft glow, polished realistic studio lighting, nicer/more modern UI treatment. B04 (AVELUNE app) will be regenerated since the accepted version used the old couch-background style.

Switched all brand-wordmark images to Nano Banana Pro regardless of photographic style - it renders short wordmarks (AVELUNE) correctly and reliably where Seedream 4.5 is less predictable with text; text accuracy matters more than the marginal grain/lighting difference here.

Promit feedback round 6: (a) renamed the accounting/financial brand from invented 'LEDGER & CO' to QUANTIVA - this is a real prior client (Quantiva Consulting), so its 3 images were simplified to a modern/minimalist direction rather than the ornate emerald+gold neumorphic look; (b) reworked AERON headphones/earbuds (C01, C03) toward a transparent-housing 'see-through tech' visual language (style-inspired only, no logos or trade dress copied) since the closed-shell shape wasn't liked; (c) added a 'single hero product on a lacquer-black pedestal under one hard overhead spotlight, extreme minimalism' luxury-advertising framing to the AERON pieces, taking compositional inspiration from high-fashion product photography (restraint, negative space, single dramatic light) rather than any specific brand's imagery.

model_rationale.seedream-4.5: Stylized creative expert; renders authentic film grain and photographic compositional detail where Nano Banana Pro reads sterile. Used for all 26 Family A editorial/abstract images.
model_rationale.nano-banana-pro: Realism expert; benchmarks ahead on UI mockups and spatial logic. Used for the 6 Family B device/browser mockups.
